name: Vaultdoor
summary:
Vaultdoor keeps private photos, videos, PDFs, documents and notes in an encrypted vault on your headset. Everything is encrypted with AES-256-GCM before it is written, and the vault opens only with your 4-digit PIN, backed by the headset's Android Keystore. A recovery key, shown once when you create the vault, opens it if you forget the PIN.

There is no account, no cloud and no tracking. Vaultdoor does not connect to the internet.

What you can do:
- Add photos, videos, PDFs and text files from the headset
